qty.description: Number of shares. Mutually exclusive with notional.

notional.description:
Dollar amount to trade. Mutually exclusive with qty.
      Only valid for market orders with time_in_force="day".

limit_price.description: Required for limit and stop_limit orders.

stop_price.description: Required for stop and stop_limit orders.

trail_price.description: Dollar trail amount for trailing_stop orders.

extended_hours.description:
Allow execution in pre-market, after-hours, and
            overnight sessions. Only works with type="limit"
            and time_in_force="day" or "gtc".

client_order_id.description:
Unique idempotency key. If the request times out,
             you can safely retry with the same value — the API
             will reject duplicates. Recommended for every order.

order_class.description:
"simple", "bracket", "oco", or "oto". Automatically
         set to "bracket" when take_profit or stop_loss params
         are provided.

take_profit_limit_price.description: Limit price for bracket take-profit leg.

stop_loss_stop_price.description: Stop price for bracket stop-loss leg.

stop_loss_limit_price.description: Limit price for bracket stop-loss leg.
